Run order: `00_GAM_survey_data.Rmd` (samples and GAM site registry) ->
`python/environmental_timeseries_pull/update_env_cache.py` with both registries ->
this script (climate and KG joins, model data).

# Setup

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| output: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show setup code"

# setup
librarian::shelf(tidyverse, here, janitor, terra, arrow)

source(here("size_bd_unified", "env_functions.R"))

bd_gam_clean = readRDS(here("size_bd_gam", "intermediates", "bd_survey_gam_clean.rds"))

```

# Environmental data
```{r}
#| warning: false

# same climate cache and rolling windows as the unified pipeline (env_functions.R)
site_cells = read_site_cells(here("size_bd_gam", "intermediates", "site_registry_gam_cells.csv"),
                             bd_gam_clean$site)

env_agg_all = build_env_agg(unique(site_cells$cell_id))

bd_gam_env = join_env(bd_gam_clean, site_cells, env_agg_all)

# env standardization from the unified model data, so env slopes (and the env prior built from
# m11g co100) are on the same scale. must be the data file m11g co100 was fit to
load(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "bd_model_env_unified_2026-11-12.RData"))

unified_env_scale = list(
  precip_mean = mean(brms_data$precip_mm_10_day_sum),
  precip_sd = sd(brms_data$precip_mm_10_day_sum),
  temp_mean = mean(brms_data$temp_c_30_day_mean),
  temp_sd = sd(brms_data$temp_c_30_day_mean))

rm(brms_data)

brms_data = bd_gam_env %>%
  mutate(life_stage_simple = factor(life_stage_simple, levels = c("metamorph", "subadult", "adult")),
         is_metamorph = as.numeric(life_stage_simple == "metamorph"),
         is_not_metamorph = as.numeric(life_stage_simple != "metamorph"),
         precip_mm_10_z = (precip_mm_10_day_sum - unified_env_scale$precip_mean) / unified_env_scale$precip_sd,
         temp_c_30_z = (temp_c_30_day_mean - unified_env_scale$temp_mean) / unified_env_scale$temp_sd)

```

# KG zones
```{r}
# use the unified pipeline's site-level KG assignments (size_bd_unified/01_model_data.Rmd)
unified_sites_kg = read_csv(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "size_bd_modeling_sites.csv")) %>%
  mutate(site = as.character(site)) %>%
  select(site,
         kg_id,
         kg_code_1,
         kg_code_2,
         kg_code_3)

# fallback: extract KG for any GAM sites not in the unified site table, as in the unified pipeline
kg_key = read_csv(here("data", "koppen_geiger_tif", "legend.csv")) %>%
  select(-rgb) %>%
  rename_with(function(x) { paste0("kg_", x) })

missing_sites = brms_data %>%
  filter(!(site %in% unified_sites_kg$site)) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(site_latitude = mean(site_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            site_longitude = mean(site_longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

if (nrow(missing_sites) > 0) {
  kg_rast = rast(here("data", "koppen_geiger_tif", "1991_2020", "koppen_geiger_0p00833333.tif"))

  missing_sites_kg = missing_sites %>%
    bind_cols(extract(kg_rast, cbind(lon = missing_sites$site_longitude,
                                     lat = missing_sites$site_latitude))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(kg_id = koppen_geiger_0p00833333) %>%
    mutate(kg_id = if_else(kg_id == 29, 19, kg_id)) %>%
    left_join(kg_key, by = "kg_id") %>%
    select(site,
           kg_id,
           kg_code_1,
           kg_code_2,
           kg_code_3)

  unified_sites_kg = bind_rows(unified_sites_kg, missing_sites_kg)
}

missing_sites

brms_data = brms_data %>%
  left_join(unified_sites_kg, by = "site")

```

# data visual summaries
```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

stage_colors = c(metamorph = "#E69F00", subadult = "#56B4E9", adult = "#0072B2")
n_svl_bins = 30

# post-metamorphic svl, binned per species so each panel gets its own binwidth
svl_binned = brms_data %>%
  filter(life_stage_simple != "metamorph") %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  mutate(svl_min = min(svl_mm),
         binwidth = (max(svl_mm) - svl_min) / n_svl_bins,
         bin_mid = svl_min + (pmin(floor((svl_mm - svl_min) / binwidth), n_svl_bins - 1) + 0.5) * binwidth) %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple, bin_mid, binwidth, svl_min) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# metamorph counts as a single bar placed to the left of each species' svl axis
meta_bars = brms_data %>%
  filter(life_stage_simple == "metamorph") %>%
  count(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple) %>%
  inner_join(distinct(svl_binned, taxon_capture, binwidth, svl_min), by = "taxon_capture") %>%
  mutate(bin_mid = svl_min - 2 * binwidth)

(svl_hist = ggplot(mapping = aes(x = bin_mid, y = n, fill = life_stage_simple)) +
  geom_col(data = svl_binned, aes(width = binwidth), position = "stack") +
  geom_col(data = meta_bars, aes(width = binwidth)) +
  geom_text(data = meta_bars, aes(label = n), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ taxon_capture, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stage_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "SVL (mm); metamorph count shown as separate bar at left",
       y = "Samples",
       fill = "Life stage") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

```

```{r}
# shared binning and plotting for the seasonal (week x svl) tile plots below.
#   week_width: x binwidth in weeks (week 53 folded into 52; a last partial period is kept)
#   svl_binwidth: y binwidth in mm, either one value for all species or a named vector by
#     taxon_capture. NULL gives each species n_svl_bins bins over its own svl range
#   min_n_week: columns (week periods) with fewer samples are dropped

# subadult / adult svl cutoffs (mm) for the species in the data, from the shared stage rules
# (size_bd_unified/svl_stage_cutoffs.R); species staged from field labels have no cutoff
source(here("size_bd_unified", "svl_stage_cutoffs.R"))

svl_cutoffs = svl_cutoff_species(unique(brms_data$taxon_capture)) %>%
  select(taxon_capture, svl_cutoff_mm = svl_mm_cutoff) %>%
  filter(!is.na(svl_cutoff_mm))

resolve_svl_binwidth = function(taxon, svl_range, svl_binwidth, n_svl_bins) {
  if (is.null(svl_binwidth)) {
    return(svl_range / n_svl_bins)
  }
  if (is.null(names(svl_binwidth))) {
    stopifnot(length(svl_binwidth) == 1)
    return(svl_binwidth)
  }
  if (!(taxon %in% names(svl_binwidth))) {
    stop("svl_binwidth has no value for ", taxon)
  }
  unname(svl_binwidth[taxon])
}

# sample-level column (center of each week_width period, in week units) and svl bin (center)
bin_week_svl = function(data, week_width = 1, svl_binwidth = NULL, n_svl_bins = 30, min_n_week = 10) {
  data %>%
    mutate(week = pmin(ceiling(yday(date) / 7), 52),
           week = (ceiling(week / week_width) - 0.5) * week_width + 0.5) %>%
    group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
    mutate(svl_min = min(svl_mm),
           binwidth = resolve_svl_binwidth(cur_group()$taxon_capture, max(svl_mm) - svl_min,
                                           svl_binwidth, n_svl_bins),
           n_bins_spp = pmax(ceiling((max(svl_mm) - svl_min) / binwidth), 1),
           svl_bin = svl_min + (pmin(floor((svl_mm - svl_min) / binwidth), n_bins_spp - 1) + 0.5) * binwidth) %>%
    group_by(taxon_capture, week) %>%
    filter(n() >= min_n_week) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-n_bins_spp)
}

# shared tile layers. coord_cartesian (not scale limits) so a partial last period is not dropped
season_tile_base = function(cells, week_width, show_cutoffs = TRUE) {
  ggplot(cells, aes(x = week, y = svl_bin, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(aes(height = binwidth), width = week_width) +
    (if (show_cutoffs) geom_hline(data = svl_cutoffs, aes(yintercept = svl_cutoff_mm),
                                  linetype = "dashed", color = "#333", linewidth = 0.5)) +
    facet_wrap(~ taxon_capture, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = month_start_weeks,
                       labels = month.abb) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, 52.5), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "SVL (mm)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

period_label = function(week_width) {
  if (week_width == 1) "weeks" else paste0(week_width, "-week periods")
}

```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

# svl distribution through the season: density within each column, scaled so each column's peak
# = 1. a second bright band within a column suggests a distinct size cohort (e.g. young of the
# year). all life stages included (metamorphs anchor the yoy cohort). sparse columns are dropped,
# since a single animal would otherwise scale to full intensity.
svl_density_tile = function(data, week_width = 1, svl_binwidth = NULL, n_svl_bins = 30,
                            min_n_week = 10, show_cutoffs = FALSE) {
  cells = bin_week_svl(data, week_width, svl_binwidth, n_svl_bins, min_n_week) %>%
    group_by(taxon_capture, week, svl_bin, binwidth) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(taxon_capture, week) %>%
    mutate(value = n / max(n)) %>%
    ungroup()

  season_tile_base(cells, week_width, show_cutoffs) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(fill = "Density within column\n(peak = 1)",
         caption = paste0(str_to_sentence(period_label(week_width)), " with fewer than ",
                          min_n_week, " samples omitted."))
}

(svl_season_tile = svl_density_tile(brms_data, week_width = 1, n_svl_bins = 30))

```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

# bd prevalence and load (co100) in week x svl cells. bd levels are not comparable between
# species (labs differ), so each cell is centered on its species' overall value (all of that
# species' swabs) and shown on a diverging scale:
#   prevalence: empirical log odds of detection, cell minus species (log odds ratio); cells
#     need >= min_n_cell swabs
#   load: mean log(bd load density) among positives, cell minus species (log fold difference);
#     cells need >= min_pos_cell positives
# color limits are symmetric at the 95th percentile of |value|, more extreme cells squished.
emp_logit = function(k, n) log((k + 0.5) / (n - k + 0.5))

bd_season_tile = function(data, metric = c("prevalence", "load"), week_width = 2,
                          svl_binwidth = NULL, n_svl_bins = 15, min_n_week = 10,
                          min_n_cell = 5, min_pos_cell = 3, show_cutoffs = TRUE) {
  metric = match.arg(metric)

  spp_ref = data %>%
    group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
    summarise(spp_logit_prev = emp_logit(sum(bd_detected_co100), n()),
              spp_mean_log_load = mean(log(bd_load_co100_density[bd_detected_co100])),
              .groups = "drop")

  samples = bin_week_svl(data, week_width, svl_binwidth, n_svl_bins, min_n_week) %>%
    left_join(spp_ref, by = "taxon_capture")

  if (metric == "prevalence") {
    cells = samples %>%
      group_by(taxon_capture, week, svl_bin, binwidth, spp_logit_prev) %>%
      summarise(n = n(),
                n_pos = sum(bd_detected_co100),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      filter(n >= min_n_cell) %>%
      mutate(value = emp_logit(n_pos, n) - spp_logit_prev)

    fill_label = "Log odds ratio of detection\n(cell vs. species overall)"
    caption = paste0("Empirical logit. Cells with fewer than ", min_n_cell, " swabs")
  } else {
    cells = samples %>%
      filter(bd_detected_co100) %>%
      group_by(taxon_capture, week, svl_bin, binwidth, spp_mean_log_load) %>%
      summarise(n_pos = n(),
                mean_log_load = mean(log(bd_load_co100_density)),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      filter(n_pos >= min_pos_cell) %>%
      mutate(value = mean_log_load - spp_mean_log_load)

    fill_label = "Log fold difference in Bd load density\namong positives (cell vs. species overall)"
    caption = paste0("Cells with fewer than ", min_pos_cell, " Bd-positive swabs")
  }

  lim = quantile(abs(cells$value), 0.95)

  season_tile_base(cells, week_width, show_cutoffs) +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", limits = c(-lim, lim), oob = scales::squish) +
    labs(fill = fill_label,
         caption = paste0(caption, " and ", period_label(week_width), " with fewer than ",
                          min_n_week, " samples omitted.",
                          if (show_cutoffs) " Dashed lines: subadult / adult SVL cutoff."))
}

(bd_prev_season_tile = bd_season_tile(brms_data, "prevalence", week_width = 2, n_svl_bins = 15))

```

(bd_load_season_tile = bd_season_tile(brms_data, "load", week_width = 2, n_svl_bins = 15))
